summary: Iteration 8 — Sales owner-edit + admin drill-down/reassign/delete for calls & sales. Backend: 22/23 passing on /app/backend/tests/test_iteration8_perms_drilldown.py (junit /app/test_reports/pytest/iteration8.xml). 1 real bug found: GET /api/admin/users/{u}/sales does NOT compute profit — it returns raw DB docs through response_model=List[Sale], and since raw docs don't carry a persisted 'profit' field, Pydantic falls back to the model default 0.0. Every sale returned by this admin drill-down endpoint has profit=0.0 regardless of amount/purchase_amount. All other endpoints validated: PATCH /api/sales/{sid} owner can update amount/product/notes (200); owner blocked from purchase_amount (403); non-owner non-admin (403); admin can update everything (profit correctly recalculates in the PATCH RESPONSE, only the LIST endpoint is buggy); unknown sid (404). DELETE /api/sales/{sid} admin=200, employee=403. GET /api/admin/users/{u}/calls admin-only, sorted newest-first, limit param clamped, 404 unknown. GET /api/admin/users/{u}/sales admin-only, correct shape, 404 unknown. POST /api/admin/calls/reassign & /sales/reassign admin-only, empty ids=400, target must be employee, verified moved docs appear under new owner and sales display_name cache is updated to target's display_name. DELETE /api/admin/calls/{cid} admin-only, 404 on unknown, cascade verified. Frontend mobile smoke (390x844): /team row tap navigates to /team/emp1 (member-screen rendered with header '@emp1 · 13 calls · 4 sales', tabs 'Calls (13)'/'Sales (4)' working); pencil icon [team-edit-emp1] still opens original edit sheet (edit-display-name field present) — no regression. On /team/emp1 sales tab, tapping a row makes bulk-move-btn appear and opening it shows 6 'move-to-<emp>' options (correct — excludes emp1 self, includes 6 other employees). Login as emp1 → /sales shows 4 edit-own-<id> pencils on their rows, zero edit-purchase pencils (admin-only field correctly hidden). Edit-own sheet opens with own-amount/own-product/own-notes/save-own testIDs all present. No red-screens, no react-native issues.

minor.issue: Returns raw dicts via response_model=List[Sale]; Sale.profit defaults to 0.0 and profit is never persisted, so this endpoint always returns profit=0.0 even when amount > purchase_amount. Fix: pipe results through sale_from_doc(d) like list_sales does. Reference: /app/backend/server.py L766-772 (admin_user_sales) vs L1435 (list_sales uses sale_from_doc).

action_items: Fix profit calculation in GET /api/admin/users/{username}/sales — replace the raw docs return with [sale_from_doc(d) for d in docs] (server.py ~L766-772). Currently the admin-facing drill-down shows profit=0.0 for every sale even after admin sets purchase_amount.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py L1439-1471 patch_sale — good ordering: find-first, then authorize (owner-or-admin), then purchase_amount admin gate. Profit is computed at read-time in sale_from_doc so no denorm drift on PATCH.
server.py L1475-1481 delete_sale — correctly narrowed to admin_only. Employees can't delete their own even by accident.

server.py L775-806 reassign endpoints — validation on target role='employee' correctly blocks reassigning to admin (which would leak into admin-scoped views). Sales reassign also refreshes cached display_name — good, prevents stale UI in leaderboards.
server.py L809-815 admin_delete_call — no cascade needed since call_logs are audit-only (customer/date_key still coherent). Good.
server.py L737-772 admin_user_calls / admin_user_sales — the calls endpoint returns raw docs (fine, no computed fields). The sales endpoint has the profit bug noted above.

team/[username].tsx L194 bulk-move-btn — only rendered when selection.size > 0, avoiding empty-selection UX. Modal at L340 filters out the current member (`.filter(u => u.username !== username)`) so admin can't reassign to self — good.

sales.tsx L202 edit-own-<id> pencil — gated by `item.user === user.username && user.role !== 'admin'`. Correct: admin sees edit-purchase (admin-only field), employees see edit-own for their own rows only. Good separation.
sales.tsx L316 save-own PATCH — sends only amount/product/notes (never purchase_amount) so the client is aligned with the server's owner-restriction. Good.

rca_of_issue: GET /api/admin/users/{u}/sales — Bug RCA: Endpoint at server.py L756-772 does `docs = await db.sales.find(...).to_list(limit); return docs`. Because it declares `response_model=List[Sale]` FastAPI passes each raw dict through Pydantic Sale(**d) coercion. The Sale model at L238-251 has `profit: float = 0.0` as a computed-but-not-persisted field. Since the source DB doc has NO 'profit' key (profit is only ever computed at serialization time by sale_from_doc, not stored), Pydantic uses the default 0.0. Reproduction: 1) admin creates a sale for emp1 with amount=1200, 2) admin PATCH sets purchase_amount=800 (response correctly shows profit=400 because patch handler uses sale_from_doc), 3) admin GETs /api/admin/users/emp1/sales → the same sale shows profit=0.0. Mitigation (1-line): `return [sale_from_doc(d) for d in docs]`.
